mods.name: OdinExtras
mods.description: An addon to Odin with various features for Hypixel Skyblock.

releases.notes:
### *First full release of OdinExtras.*
If this is your first time using the mod, I would heavily suggest [checking out the features list.](https://github.com/DaPrimeAtce/OdinExtras/blob/26.1/FEATURES.md)

## Changes since the beta:

- Added Teammate Deaths
- Added 300 Score Message & various 270 Score features (accessible through the base MapInfo module)
- Added customizable Leap Message (accessible through the base Leap Menu module)
- Added Co-op Chat and Party Finder messages to Chat Logger
- Added Privacy Clear to Chat Logger
- Rewrote Chat Commands+ (it is now almost entirely fully customizable and replaces base Chat Commands)
- Moved Tick Timers+ features to base Tick Timers module
- Moved Extra Splits features to base Splits module
- Moved Click GUI+ features to base Click GUI module
- Added the command /oe hud, opens the HUD editor
- Changed the default Mod Message prefix for OdinExtras features to be "OdinExtras" instead of Odin's prefix
- Changed the command /oe chatcommandsplus to instead be /oe chatemotes to make it more clear what the command does
- Removed Resource Pack as it was causing crashes and would be a pain to maintain long term
- Fixed Kick Random command in Chat Commands+ returning an error when the player is in a solo party
- Compatibility with Odin 0.3.1 (This fixes crashes caused by the update)

## Note:

There should *hopefully* be no bugs, as I did extensive testing, however things could have still missed the initial testing. Please let me know if you encounter any bugs! 

The Privacy Clear added to Chat Logger is a privacy feature for players who want to share their modpacks/configs and don't want other players logging to the same webhook URL.

releases.notes:
Mostly a small update to patch the Chat Commands Plus exploit (players with bad intentions were abusing chat commands from various mods to disconnect other players)

## Added:

- Added Click GUI+
- Added Resource Pack
- Added Teammate Nametags
- Added Storm DPS Splits Timer to Extra Splits

## Changes / Fixes:

- Reorganized Extra Splits module, each split timer is now it's own HUD (You may have to reconfigure the HUDs)
- Removed redundant "From" formatting in Chat Logger private messages
- Added "tyfrs" as a prefix to trigger the "tyfr" command in Chat Commands Plus
- Fixed Arrow Poison Display checking for arrow poison when the feature is off
- Various cleanup and organization (this is more of a technical change, but may still break stuff)
- Fixed Chat Commands Plus allowing names above the Minecraft username character limit (should hopefully fix people abusing this)

## Note:

**The mod is still in beta, expect there to be bugs. 
The beta will be updated frequently with fixes and/or new additions.**
